changes: Fixed the reader closing a few seconds into some chapters
Fixed the reader closing on phones that can't run sharpening; it now just turns itself off there
Page tint: the reader's menus, bars and mini player take on the colours of the page you're reading (turn it off in reader settings)
Tilt to scroll for webtoons: tap the rotate button in the reader, then tip the top of your phone away to scroll down and toward you to go back up
Spoiler shield: titles of unread chapters past your next one stay blurred until you tap them (Settings → Library)
Egg timer: pick a 10 to 60 minute reading session and an egg cooks in the corner, then hatches into your weekly egg carton in Stats
Stats reworked: a compact streak card with your last 7 days, the calendar when you want it, a weekly goal bar, this week against last week, and an easier to read habits list
Avatars: build your own egg or alien egg from 176 items, unlocked by your achievements and ranks, with rank borders from Raw Egg to Cosmic (plus a secret one)
Your avatar, rank and XP sit at the top of the More tab, on your achievements card, and show up when you compare with a friend
Fixed the music player jumping to the top of the reader
Fixed updates failing the first time they download
Patch notes: after an update you see everything new since the last version you opened, even if you skipped a few
Settings → About → What's new now shows every Eggiku update

Smart tab in the Library: ready-made smart categories (Ready to binge, Nearly caught up, Dropped?, Stalled, Finished but never read, Top shelf, Fresh, Ready for offline) plus your own, built from rules. Nothing ever moves out of your categories
Your own coloured tags on series, shown on covers. Search #tagname in the Library to find them
Star rating and tags now sit right under the cover; a reading timeline on series pages
Reader: chapter-end card with time spent, streak and a bookmark button
Reader: hold a page to pop the panel up; let go to close it
Reader: about how many minutes are left in the chapter, a glow on the last page, page-turn vibration
Stats: genre breakdown, reading speed, and a monthly Wrapped notification
Compare achievements with a friend using a code
Glass look on pop-up sheets, three new hidden themes, app icon choices and app fonts
Browse: source speed test, recent and saved searches
Undo after marking read or deleting downloads on series pages and in Updates
Achievement ladders with lots of small tiers, counting all your reading history
18 badges plus 5 secret ones, and a shareable achievements card
Reworked sharpening that's much easier to see
Live sharpening and full-resolution long strip pages for sharper zoom (separate for folded and unfolded)
One-hand mode and a skipped chapter warning in the reader
Migrations: best source pick with side-by-side comparison, unsure matches held back, chapter numbering lined up, move a whole source at once, nudges when a series keeps failing
Star ratings, Top shelf, Dead series finder, achievements, Wrapped card you can save, smart downloads
The egg intro now plays on every phone
Fixed Find duplicates closing the app
Fixed Settings closing the app with the phone unfolded
Egg intro animation when the app opens
Eggiku updates in More: see your build against the newest one and install it in one tap
Find duplicates: keeps the one you've read most and merges progress, with undo
Migration preview, report and Undo last migration
Send your latest backup straight to Google Drive
Home screen widget with your streak, weekly goal and continue-reading covers
Cooking shelf and "cook until X new chapters"
Continue reading: swipe to skip, plus nudges for series you binged then dropped
Quick sort your library into categories, share a series with a friend, two more hidden themes
